title: Expose claim criterion coverage and contradictory evidence
description: Builds a bounded view of applicable observations, uncovered criteria, and material contradictory evidence for a declared engineering claim. It supplies transparent assessment inputs rather than replacing engineering interpretation with a mechanical passing status.
inputs: Declared claim scope, exact subject state, and requirement criterion basis.
Evidence applicability assessments, actual observations, and recorded contradiction dispositions.
preconditions: The claim's included criteria and subject basis are identified; unavailable support is represented explicitly.
outputs: Per-criterion support, missing or inapplicable observations, and unresolved material contradictions.
Scope requiring further verification or judgment, including support affected by changed bases.
behavior: Account for every criterion included in the declared claim and associate available applicable observations without fabricating missing results.
Expose contrary observations and their recorded disposition; keep unresolved material contradictions visible even when favorable results also exist.
Separate supported portions from gaps and show which affected verification remains unperformed after changes.
Bound mechanical conclusions to the available recorded support; leave semantic sufficiency to the accountable judgment.

failure_behavior.condition: Criterion coverage or evidence applicability is incomplete.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the uncovered or uncertain scope and prevent it from appearing fully supported.

failure_behavior.condition: Material contradictory evidence has no adequate recorded disposition.
failure_behavior.outcome: Keep the conflict visible and the affected support unresolved rather than choosing the favorable observation.

failure_behavior.condition: Changed criteria or subject basis invalidate the current coverage view.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the need to rebuild coverage against the new basis without inheriting the earlier conclusion.

sources.basis: SR-028 and SR-029 confirm explicit criterion coverage, contradiction handling, and changed-state reassessment under IR-004.

Propose MOD-007 as the single accountable architectural responsibility for the existing behavior. This allocation preserves the Function definition and does not establish implementation or completed interface/AR coverage outside the IR-001 pilot.
